artworks.title: Two Lovers
artworks.artist: attributed to John Baptist Jackson, probably after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from five blocks in shades of brown and gray on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 38.3 x 26.5 cm (15 1/16 x 10 7/16 in.) cut to block mark
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up of two individuals facing each other. The person on the left is looking forward with defined facial features and curly hair. The individual on the right is in profile, with features including a strong nose and styled hair. Both are wearing garments with voluminous collars, and the right person's hand is touching the left person's chin. The background is a neutral brown tone.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child in the Clouds with Six Saints
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks in buff and black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: image: 59 x 37.5 cm (23 1/4 x 14 3/4 in.), trimmed to block mark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with figures in clouds above a group of standing individuals. The upper portion shows a radiant dove at the center, descending with rays emanating from it, surrounded by clouds upon which several cherubic figures move. A central figure is flanked by angels. Below, a group of religious-looking figures is portrayed. The composition is highly detailed with intricate shading and uses lines and dots to create depth. In the foreground stands a bare individual slightly apart from the richly robed group. The art style resembles classic religious engravings known for their detailing and emphasis on vertical symmetry.

artworks.title: The Visitation
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson, after Annibale Carracci
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in yellow, buff, brown, and gray on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing close together in an outdoor setting. The first person wears a long robe and a hood that partially covers their head. The second person also wears a long garment and leans towards the first person, with an arm reaching around them. Both individuals have their heads inclined towards each other. Their facial features are shown with soft expressions and detailed contours. In the background, there is a landscape with a building, likely a church, rolling hills, and a cloudy sky. A column and a balustrade are visible on the right. The scene conveys a classical or historical atmosphere, with attention to the details of their garments and the serene environment.

artworks.title: Woman Meditating
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks in brown and black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 13 x 24 cm (5 1/8 x 9 7/16 in.) cut to block mark
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a person sitting. The person is seated in a three-quarter view, slightly leaning forward and looking downward. Their facial features are softly defined with a serene expression, and their hair is styled in waves pulled back. They wear a long, draped garment with flowing lines and their hands rest on their lap, cradling an unseen object. There is a decorative urn or vase on a pedestal in the background against a vertically lined wall. The engraving is bordered with a rectangular frame and is accompanied by a piece of Italian poetic text.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid with a Bow
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from four blocks in blue-gray, light brown, brown, and black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure entwined with a small winged cherub. The figure appears relaxed, leaning on pillows with one arm, while the other interacts with the cherub. The background shows drapery and clouds. The use of delicate lines and cross-hatching provides depth and texture. The lower portion of the drawing contains text crediting the creator.

artworks.title: The Holy Family and Two Angels
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a child on her lap. The woman is seated to the left of the composition and is looking upwards. Her hair is styled in curls, and she wears a long flowing garment. The child on her lap is also looking up, with curly hair and dressed in a simple robe. To the right, another child with curly hair is holding a lamb. An older man with long hair and a beard stands behind the woman, gesturing with his hand. In the right background, an angel is playing a stringed instrument with large wings visible behind him. At the lower left, another winged figure is depicted holding a similar musical instrument. The background includes architectural elements like columns and draped curtains.

artworks.title: A Dromedary
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a camel in a stylized landscape setting. The camel has detailed curly fur and textured skin. In the background, there are stylized clouds and abstract representations of trees, rocky formations, and mountains. The artwork emphasizes the details of the camel's fur and the ruggedness of the landscape through a linear technique.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Neptune and Thetis
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 27.8 x 41.1 cm (10 15/16 x 16 3/16 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with figures and creatures in a fantastical landscape. The drawing depicts numerous figures interacting in a dynamic composition. Central to the image is a scene involving humanoid figures interacting with serpentine creatures in the foreground. Above, winged cherubic figures playfully fly through the sky, carrying branches or wreaths. In the background, a cloud looms over the scene with a prominent figure seemingly directing the action below. To the far right, figures appear to gather or move with a backdrop of distant hills. The drawing showcases intricate details and fine lines, suggesting movement and vibrancy.

artworks.title: Apollo as Sol
artworks.artist: Jacob Matham, after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem

artworks.title: Diana as Luna Accompanying a Young Man Serenading
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lute player and a figure with a halo strolling through an elaborate garden. The garden features sculptural fountains, statues, and lush greenery. A dog is seen exploring the water near a fountain adorned with winged figures and faces. In the background, additional figures are engaged in various activities. The scene is intricately detailed with a classical mythological theme.

artworks.title: John the Baptist, Preaching
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 26.7 x 25.1 cm (10 1/2 x 9 7/8 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a rocky landscape. The scene features figures in different poses across rocky terrain with canyons and a body of water in the background. The figures are depicted in a classical style, some partially undressed. The rocks and figures are detailed with hatching and cross-hatching techniques for texture and depth. Light and shadow are used to create a dramatic effect, with figures illuminated while others are in shadow. Cloud-like lines in the sky direct focus towards the central and background figures.

artworks.title: Alfonso X, King of Castile
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing confidently. He is dressed in medieval armor and holds a spear. His facial features include a beard and a determined expression, partially concealed by a hat. The background features an archway and rolling hills with medieval structures.

artworks.title: Moses and the Burning Bush
artworks.description: The image shows a city with red roofs and stone buildings stretching across the center, bordered by green landscape below a pale sky. In the foreground, a figure in a red robe stands on a grassy hill, gesturing towards the horizon. Smoke and flames rise from a forest to the right, while sheep graze on a slope. Two figures are to the left near a tall tree. The color palette includes earth tones, reds, greens, and gray, with bold, expressive strokes typical of woodcut techniques.

artworks.title: David Playing the Harp before Saul
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a narrative scene set in an architectural interior. The image shows multiple figures engaged in what seems to be a historical or biblical story. A figure on the left, holding a harp, is speaking to another figure seated on a throne to the right, who is crowned and dressed regally. An intermediary figure stands between them holding a staff, with a small object on a table nearby. The background includes a landscape visible through an arcade, featuring rolling hills and a building. The piece is highly detailed, showcasing intricate decorative elements on the columns, throne, and surrounding architecture. The style is reminiscent of detailed Renaissance drawings that combine allegorical and historical storytelling with rich architectural elements.

artworks.title: Mars and Venus Caught by the Gods
artworks.artist: Hans Collaert the Younger, after Philip Galle
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting mythological figures in a classical scene. The figures are in an ornately decorated interior, with one central figure on a couch. Each figure is detailed with muscular bodies and dramatic poses. The setting is opulent with elaborate patterns and luxurious textiles. There are symbolic items held by some figures, and an elegantly draped backdrop adds depth. The drawing is framed by decorative elements.

artworks.title: Ryno et Hermangarde (Ryno and Hermangarde)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, softground etching, salt lift, aquatint (spirit ground) and roulette in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a horseman in full gallop across a rugged landscape, with a tumultuous sky overhead. Surrounding the central image are intricate marks and forms, possibly clouds or abstract elements, creating a sense of motion and intensity. The drawing is detailed, with fine lines capturing the texture of the horse's mane and the folds of the rider's clothes. Light and shadow are used to create strong contrast, enhancing the dramatic atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Allegory of War
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical battle scene. The image portrays a battlefield filled with soldiers, musicians, and other characters engaged in various activities. A figure symbolizing victory flies through the sky on clouds in the upper center. In the background, military camps and formations of troops stretch across a hilly landscape. Banners, drums, and chariots add to the dynamic composition, while detailed line work emphasizes action and movement. Latin names label the figures in the scene.

artworks.title: The Body of Christ Supported by Angels
artworks.description: The image depicts a central figure in a seated position on the edge of a flat surface. The person is half-nude, with a cloth draped over the lower part of their body. The figure's head is tilted downward, eyes closed. They have sharp facial features, long wavy hair, and are supported by an angel. The angel has long hair and wings. Two cherubs are present, one holding the man's hand and the other holding a container. In the background, there is a rocky landscape with a faint outline of a distant city, and three more figures walking. The scene is detailed with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in the foreground. One is a woman seated on a low bench, facing to the right. She has a serene expression and her hair is covered. She wears a draped garment and her hand rests near her chest. The second figure is an angelic being kneeling on one knee, facing towards the seated woman. The angel has flowing hair, detailed wings, and holds a stem of flowers. In the background, there are cherubic figures among clouds with a radiant light at the center emanating from a dove. Beams of light surround the figures. A table on the left corner holds a book, a basket with circular objects, and some writing is visible.

artworks.title: Hans Bol
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 26.4 x 18.1 cm (10 3/8 x 7 1/8 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a man in a Renaissance-era outfit. He has distinct facial features, with a broad nose, pronounced cheekbones, full beard, and mustache. His hair is short and slightly wavy, and he is looking towards the viewer. The man is elegantly dressed with a ruffled collar and a textured doublet with quilted sleeves. The frame surrounding him features cherubs holding scientific instruments, floral and fruit motifs, scrollwork, and a skull at the bottom center. The background is filled with intricate details enhancing the overall ornate aesthetic.

artworks.title: Pygmalion and Galatea
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a classical setting. The person on the left is standing upright and the person on the right is seated on an ornately carved object. The standing figure has delicate facial features with a serene expression, and their hair is styled in soft waves. They appear to be partially clothed with a draped garment covering the lower part of their body. The seated individual has a muscular build, curly hair, and is looking at the standing person. They are wearing what appears to be a hat or helmet and have a piece of cloth tied around their waist. The seated person holds a chisel in one hand and outstretches the other, offering a branch with leaves to the standing figure. The background features an arched architectural element, providing a classical setting to the scene. Various objects, including a small hammer and chisel, are scattered around their feet.

artworks.title: St. Mary Magdalen Penitent
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing against a rock formation, looking down at a book she holds. She has long wavy hair, a gentle expression, and is wearing a flowing garment with bare feet. She holds a skull in her left hand and there is an urn by her feet. The background displays a rugged landscape with trees, rocks, and a distant cross on a hill, under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Titus Manlius Torquatus
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular man in a combat stance. He stands with one leg forward and his torso twisted. He has a focused expression with a strong jawline and a mustache. The man wears a helmet with a plume and classical armor, showcasing his muscles. A garment drapes over his shoulder. The background depicts a battle scene with a cloudy sky and figures holding spears or lances in the distance.

artworks.title: The Allegory of Fame and History
artworks.description: This print features a scene with a winged, angelic woman playing a trumpet above a landscape with ancient ruins and mountains. Below the woman is a pedestal with a skull, an open book, and an urn. Beside the pedestal, on the right, is another nude woman who kneels on the ground, looking at the open book. One of her legs is partially inside a hole in the ground at the bottom right corner of the print. She holds a small square object in one hand that appears to be burning or emitting smoke, with one bird sitting on it and another bird emerging from the smoke. Behind this woman is a horse or deer, its head bent towards the ground. In the air between the two women, an hourglass with wings floats. The background includes architectural elements like columns and towers on a hilly landscape covered with shards of broken pottery. The sky above is empty. There are two columns of text below the print.
